newsitem.title: USA: Bio Fluorescent sets reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Bio Fluorescent sets reverse split.

text.p: Bio-Fluorescent Technologies Inc said on Wednesday that it has authorized a 3-for-1 reverse split of its common stock, effective December 2.
The company said the move should position its stock for "a more advantageous market price."
The total number of shares outstanding after the reverse split will be 5,937,378, with 8,333,334 shares authorized.
The company also said in a statement that it "continues to be aggressive in its acquisition policy and will release information on activity in this area in the near future."
